question: Do independent source-visible +700-032+, +700-033+, or +033-700+ controls support the recorded R/L component policy used in the H-938/H-910 gate?
answer: They support component coherence, not source-grade direction proof. In the three independent source-visible controls in hand, recorded R/L places 700 on the vertical/bar component and 032/033 on the V/leaf/loop component. H-930 and H-789 are clean two-panel controls; H-942 B is source-visible but side-mapping remains a local sign-count inference. This makes the recorded R/L policy less arbitrary, but it still needs source/corpus direction notes or stronger independent controls before becoming a source-grade direction rule.

component_coherence_under_recorded_RL.H-930_B: 700 maps to right vertical/bar group; 032 maps to left V/leaf component
component_coherence_under_recorded_RL.H-789_B: 700 maps to left vertical/bar group; 033 maps to right loop/oval component
component_coherence_under_recorded_RL.H-942_B: 700 maps to left vertical/bar group; 033 maps to right V/leaf component, if the B-side local mapping holds

effect_on_h938_h910: The H-938/H-910 negative component result is strengthened as a conditional working result, because independent controls align 700 with the vertical/bar component under recorded R/L. If the direction policy fails, the result remains unresolved, not positive.
next_gate: Acquire source notes or source-visible panels for H-1302/H-1303/H-2146/H-319/H-1284 or an equivalent independent 034/032/033/700 control where side mapping and component visibility are both secure.
